bio: The Queen’s Head is located in the picturesque village of East Clandon, less than 5 miles from Guildford town centre.  Indulge in a delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  The menu includes the highest quality, seasonal, farm to table ingredients packed into traditional Afternoon Tea delights.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday from 12pm - 5pm and bookings must be made at least 3 days in advance.
